page_title: BRE 0-2 TOU | Brest v Toulouse 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is adjudged offside.
90+3' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
90+2' That's a clear yellow card. Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) goes into the book.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) for Pape Demba.
89' Pape Demba (Toulouse) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
88' Joris Chotard (Brest) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
88' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
87' Hamidou Makalou (Brest) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

87' Pathe Mboup (Brest) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. Brest force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' The ball is cleared after Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Remy Labeau Lascary is replaced by Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
83' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
80' Substitution. Santiago Hidalgo did his best and is replaced by Julian Vignolo (Toulouse).
79' Pape Demba (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Daouda Guindo (Brest) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
76' The percentage of ball possession is – 55:45.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Magnetti.
73' A cross by Daouda Guindo (Brest) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
71' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
70' Daouda Guindo (Brest) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
68' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Gregoire Coudert stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
67' Kenny Lala (Brest) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
67' The free kick from long range, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Brest get a free kick.
65' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' A clumsy foul by Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) and Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle.
61' 10:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
59' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Guillaume Restes rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
59' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

57' A more precise finish was all that was needed for this set play to have been a success. Daouda Guindo (Brest) received the ball far out and fired a projectile which went yards wide of the left post.
56' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
54' Guillaume Paradis shows a yellow card to Daouda Guindo (Brest) for his blatant foul.
53' Joris Chotard (Brest) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Guillaume Restes was alert and the score remains the same.
52' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

52' Pathe Mboup (Brest) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Guillaume Restes. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brest.
51' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is penalised for a foul. Guillaume Paradis had a clear view and blows his whistle.
51' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a cross in and finds Ludovic Ajorque inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
50' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) offside.
48' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' Pape Demba (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
46' The game is over for Lucas Tousart. Pathe Mboup (Brest) comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' 0 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Yann Gboho (Toulouse) and Pape Demba gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 0:2.
43' Brest are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' 3:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
40' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Lucas Tousart (Brest) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
37' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) commits a foul after dangerous play.
36' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
34' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) whips in a cross from the corner, but Gregoire Coudert is well positioned and punches the ball away.

34' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
32' Neat passing move from Toulouse in order to create new attacking opportunities.

27' 0 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Pape Demba (Toulouse) as he collected a pass and fired an unstoppable thunderbolt, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. The shot went straight into the bottom left corner.
26' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is able to continue to play.
23' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Pape Demba (Toulouse) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
22' 49:51 – the latest ball possession ratio.
21' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillaume Paradis saw the whole situation.
19' Dangerous play by Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse). Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Guillaume Paradis and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) is caught offside!
13' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends a long ball in, but Gregoire Coudert comfortably gathers the ball.
12' Kenny Lala (Brest) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
11' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' Great teamplay by Toulouse as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregoire Coudert intercepts the ball.

4' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.s a beautiful mid-range volley low to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score doesn't change.
2' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Toulouse will kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis will supervise the game today.
